run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of ways n friends can pair up or remain single
test_f_gold: test f_gold against expected results for various input values of n
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming solution for the friends pairing problem
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization instead of a bottom-up DP array
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that solves the friends pairing problem using dynamic programming
